name: @xprite/ui
description: Reusable React primitives for pixel-art interfaces

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/generate-ui-theme.mjs && pnpm -w exec oxfmt --config infra/oxfmt.json --write packages/ui/src/base/theme/theme-name-types.ts packages/ui/src/base/theme/generated/themes/aseprite-light.ts packages/ui/src/base/theme/generated/themes/aseprite-dark.ts && vite build && tsc -b tsconfig.json --force && node ../../scripts/rewrite-package-type-imports.mjs dist/types
